title: Real-terrain transfer: evaluation on 32x32 tiles derived from HiRISE digital terrain models
status: pre-registered before the DTM data was inspected (written while the files were downloading) and before any method was run on derived tiles
purpose: External-validity check: does the v1.1 ranking of methods hold when the terrain STRUCTURE comes from real Mars elevation data instead of the procedural generator? Evaluation only: no training, no threshold change.
source: https://hirise-pds.lpl.arizona.edu/PDS/DTM/ (University of Arizona HiRISE, NASA PDS). Raw files are stored in data/hirise/ (git-ignored); derived tiles and their SHA-256 are committed.

map_construction.cell: 2 m: elevation averaged over blocks of round(2 / MAP_SCALE) x round(2 / MAP_SCALE) DTM pixels (factor >= 1); a cell is invalid if any of its pixels is the missing-data constant
map_construction.slope: degrees(arctan(|grad z|)) with numpy.gradient on the 2 m grid, spacing 2 m
map_construction.roughness: |z - mean of z over the 3x3-cell neighbourhood| in metres (local relief residual)
map_construction.site_percentiles: P97 and P20 of roughness over all valid interior cells of the site, computed once per site
map_construction.classes: obstacle if slope > 25 deg or roughness > P97(site); rock if 15 < slope <= 25 deg; sand if slope < 5 deg and roughness < P20(site); normal otherwise. Rule fixed a priori as a modelling choice (rover slope limits are typically 20-30 deg); it encodes terrain STRUCTURE, not measured traversability.
map_construction.tiles: non-overlapping 32x32 tiles on the 2 m grid, scanned row-major from the DTM origin; a tile is a candidate only if all 1024 cells are valid
map_construction.endpoints: start (0,0), goal (31,31); the 3x3 corner blocks are set to normal (landing pads), exactly as the procedural generator does
map_construction.acceptance: the simulator's own rule: goal reachable, nominal optimal cost <= 0.6 x 250, true optimal cost <= 250
map_construction.selection: accepted tiles shuffled with numpy default_rng(2026); per site at most 300 kept; the pooled kept list is shuffled again with default_rng(2027); first half -> real_pilot (debugging only), second half -> real_final (confirmatory), real_final capped at 500
map_construction.seeds: real_final tile i -> map seed 70000 + i, real_pilot tile i -> 75000 + i; the tile file and its hash are frozen before any run

physics: in-distribution sensor, slip and energy parameters (configs/sim32_id.yaml); only the terrain differs
statistics: paired by system seed on identical tiles; 95% t interval; exact sign-flip p; one condition, so Holm is applied across the comparisons within each family (primary, secondary) per metric; alpha 0.05; seedless A* paired with every seed
transfer_question: Report, descriptively, each method's change from the procedural ID condition to the real-terrain condition, and whether the qualitative v1.1 conclusions (assured has the lowest unsafe exposure; success comparable to A*+monitor; monitor drives safety) hold.
reproduction_check: before the A2 run, the v1.1 cell assured@95 / seed 0 / id must be byte-identical when re-run from the amended code
freeze: code + A2 + tile file re-frozen, tag v6.3-freeze-A2
